# Celebratory Network

> Celebratory Network is an Organization Development (OD) and Leadership Consulting firm led by CEO Payal Gupta. We design, facilitate, and implement culture-building, business transformation, family business consulting, DEIB, and large group intervention solutions for organizations globally.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://celebratorynetwork.com/): Overview of Celebratory Network, impact stats, capabilities, and client testimonials.
- [About Us](https://celebratorynetwork.com/about): Our purpose, DNA, research, team, and philosophy.
- [Contact Us](https://celebratorynetwork.com/contact): Inquiry details and office locations in India and Canada.
- [For the Record](https://celebratorynetwork.com/for-the-record): Classic library of insights, client engagements, and conversations.
- [International](https://celebratorynetwork.com/International): Cross-border OD and leadership work across the UK, US, Brazil, Germany, Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam.

## OD Consulting

- [Business OD](https://celebratorynetwork.com/od-consulting/business-od): Aligning strategy, people, and culture for lasting organizational transformation.
- [Family Businesses](https://celebratorynetwork.com/od-consulting/family-bussinesses): Transforming family-managed businesses through succession planning, leadership alignment, and professionalization.
- [Diversity and Inclusion](https://celebratorynetwork.com/od-consulting/diversity-and-inclusion): DEIB assessments, inclusive leadership journeys, and culture-change programs.

## Interventions

- [Interventions Overview](https://celebratorynetwork.com/interventions): Strategic and experiential leadership interventions.
- [Self. Role. System.](https://celebratorynetwork.com/interventions/self-role-system): Experiential framework for executives navigating complexity and systemic ambiguity.
- [Personal Power in Leadership](https://celebratorynetwork.com/interventions/personal-power-in-leadership): Research-based leadership journey for women.
- [Large Group Interventions](https://celebratorynetwork.com/interventions/large-group-intervention): World Café, AI Summit, Future Search, and Open Space interventions for organization-wide alignment.
